session_summary: Follow-up Re-entry Support session where the mentor and student reviewed a previous task (checking timetable) which was partially attempted but not completed due to scheduling difficulties. The main barrier of uncertainty regarding school procedures and managing work remains unresolved, though the student identified a manageable sub-step (asking one subject teacher for priority). A new in-session activity (sorting missed work into categories) was practiced together, providing direct support delivery within the session.
primary_concern: Uncertainty about school procedures, fluctuating ability to manage workload, and privacy concerns regarding family details. The student reports that the difficulty is inconsistent ('worse some days than others') and explicitly states they do not want to share all private family details.

tracked_details.detail: Agreed between-session task from Session 1: Student to check timetable with school office.
New agreed between-session task: Student to ask one subject teacher which work should come first.
In-session activity: Practicing sorting missed work into urgent, useful, and later categories.

next_steps: Student to attempt asking one subject teacher for work priority.
Mentor to review student's report on whether the step was completed and any barriers encountered.
uncertainties: Whether external support eligibility has been checked or confirmed.
Exact dates of absence (student reports uncertainty).
Whether the new agreed task will be completed.
Whether the in-session activity can be successfully repeated alone by the student.
conclusion: The session established a clear, small-scale action plan (asking one subject teacher) which the student found helpful. The main barrier (uncertainty and need for practical help) remains partially unresolved as external support eligibility is unconfirmed and family details are withheld. No external service was delivered; only the mentoring activity occurred. Improvement in attendance or work completion cannot be assessed yet as this is a follow-up session with no new data on those metrics.
